rows.en: "Flag 1B0 isn't set. To run this private

Otherwise, it will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Touya: "...She's not here..."
Yamato: "Huh?"
Touya: "Should we seriously have Gabon check you over?"
Yamato: "...Maybe we should..."
Aurelie: "Huh? What are you doing?"
Yamato: "Oh!"
Touya: "What are you doing over there?"
Aurelie: "What? I'm just checking my Spirit Mech,
that's all..."
Yamato: "I see... That's why I couldn't tell where you were."
Touya: "?"
Yamato: "Spirit Mechs have special magnetic fields,
and they made Aurelie's location unclear.
With all the Spirit Mechs gathered here, that's what's affecting it."
Aurelie: "...Hup."
Aurelie: "What? Did you want me?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. I just wanted to talk..."
Celica: "Well, well!"
Touya: "Whoa! Don't pop up out of nowhere!"
Celica: "How rude. I was here first.
More importantly, Touya, are you and Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Wh...! N-No! Right?"
Touya: "What?"
Celica: "..."
Aurelie: "..."
Yamato: "...Sorry about him. That's just what he's like."
Celica: "...Well, I'd better get back to work."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "Huh?"
Yamato: "Sigh..."
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's rare.
Is someone riding in it?"
Touya: "Of course someone would."
Yamato: "But it's always stopped whenever I see it,
right on the same floor too."
Touya: "You're imagining things. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it's stopped."
Fain: "Ha ha ha ha ha!
The blade of justice strikes my foes to protect the ones I love!
My red blood burns crimson! Such is a man's way of life!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I have arrived! For justice... I would die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aaah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I waited all this time for you..."
Touya: "...Go have Gabon take a look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I'm in perfect health!
I'm not so feeble that I'd fall ill!
Dah ha ha ha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...Well? How was it? I'm pretty confident
about this one. My own talent terrifies me!"
It isn't bad.
It sounds like enka.
Fain: "Right? That last part especially gives me chills,
even when I'm the one saying it."
Yamato: "He's drunk on himself... It's terminal now."
Touya: "I-I see. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm, you could describe it as 'a song of the Japanese
heart,' maybe."
Fain: "Heart? So you mean a song that resonates
directly with the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my speech must be
just as magnificent!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dah ha ha ha! You know what you're talking about!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
Dying for that would be my greatest wish!
And my justice is also for protecting the ones I care about!"
Touya: "Huh. The ones you care about..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, and for Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No, my justice isn't
so unfaithful! Oh, what am I supposed to do...?"
Yamato: "...What should we do?"
Touya: "We'd better keep our distance..."
Fain: "After all we've been through together!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I've decided there'll be only one woman I love.
But I also have the noble, supreme mission
of protecting the princess. I can give up neither loyalty nor love.
Ah... What a trial! This is the fate of a knight!
Then I shall press forward, to do battle with destiny!
No, wait. But my master said that wanting too much at once
is just the same as losing everything.
Does that mean I must choose one and stay true to it?!
Oh! How could this be?!
And to choose between Ymir and Kasumi...
Ghh! This is all those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards' fault...
If not for them, I'd never have had to suffer
like this...
Ah! Could this be their plot?!
Grrrr... Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, won't be disheartened
by something like this! Hmm? Then does that mean
that, to turn their plot against them, my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess must all be protected together?
Is that what I have to do?
No, but then I'd be going against my master's teachings.
Aaaaah! What should I do?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Hey..."
Yamato: "...He has his share of troubles."
Touya: "Well, I guess he's fulfilled in his own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
